title: A QR or NFC tag holding /\evil.com, or a join link with ?return_to=/\evil.com, sends a member off the site

source.ref: Mega pass 2026-11-19 (unknown-unknowns audit: redirects that take a user-supplied path)

detail: Mega pass 2026-11-19. Two navigations took a path from outside and checked it only for a leading single slash. lib/scan/resolve.ts returned any bare path a scanned code or NFC tag held, and components/scan/scanner.tsx pushed it; components/spaces/membership-join-card.tsx honoured ?return_to= after a join. A browser reads `/\evil.com` as `//evil.com` (and strips a tab from `/<tab>/evil.com`), so both left the site, the scanner without the foreign-host warning it exists to show. Fix: both use safeNextPath from lib/auth/safe-next.ts, the one rule sign-in already uses (no `//`, no backslash, no control or space characters). Owner-set link fields with the same starts-with check (admin/spaces actions, profile-settings, page-settings/seo, qr-splash-form) are links an owner chooses on their own page and are not changed here.

verify.note: Fails on main: both files use their own starts-with check. Passes when both use safeNextPath.
